stem:
Harsh crushes a lump of camphor into fine powder. He then stirs some of that powder in a glass of water until the bits can no longer be seen.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: After crushing, camphor particles are still present though much smaller than the lump.
When the powder can no longer be seen in the water, the camphor has become nothing.
Dissolving shows that matter is made of extremely small particles that can remain present even when unseen.

teacher.key_rationale: Crushing and dissolving leave extremely small particles present; the substance does not become nothing when it can no longer be seen.
